Wood, close your book and take off your surplice; John Green (to the clerk), leave the church: there will be no wedding to-day.’ The man obeyed. Mr. Rochester continued, hardily and recklessly: ‘Bigamy is an ugly word!—I meant, however, to be a bigamist; but fate has out- manoeuvred me, or Providence has checked me,—perhaps the last. I am little better than a devil at this moment; and, as my pastor there would tell me, deserve no doubt the sternest judgments of God, even to the quenchless fire and deathless worm.
